title: 第13章 可以开枪试试第14章 老子弄死他
content_zh:
什么，看着眼前不可思议的画面，牧华伟、张兆庆、李子茜等人禁不住开始怀疑人生，要是用力敲打也就算了，可江凡只是用手指轻轻敲打，两公分厚的大理石桌面突然碎了，江凡到底是怎么做到的？
内劲高手，刘天虎内心掀起惊涛骇浪，难以置信看向年纪轻轻的江凡，只有内劲高手可以轻松做到眼前的一幕，可江凡看似二十岁不到的年轻人，怎么可能成为内劲高手。
刹那间，偌大的至尊包厢，瞬间鸦雀无声，一众黑衣壮汉坐在墙角不敢发出丝毫声音，王胖子更是差点被吓的魂飞魄散，裆部不由自主湿了一片，李小龙也不可能强到如此地步，这年轻人到底是人是鬼？
“刘老板，你刚才说什么？”
江凡再次轻抽一口雪茄，在口腔回味片刻，再次吐出几个白色的烟圈，向着刘天虎的方向飘去。
什么叫霸气，什么叫嚣张，什么叫真男人，李子茜犹如花痴少女般看向悠闲抽着雪茄的叶凡，一时之间有些嫉妒闺蜜紫菱，自己怎么就没有江凡这样的哥哥呢。
牧华伟、张兆庆相视苦笑，战斗力如此逆天的江凡却是秦家弃少，要是秦家老爷子知道自己的嫡长孙如此牛逼，恐怕肠子都得悔青，跪请也要让江凡回归秦家！
刘天虎脸色青一阵白一阵，很是懊恼至尊包厢的隔音效果好的逆天，里面砸烂了不少家具，外面的人却听不到丝毫动静，从口袋里掏出Vertu商务手机，见江凡没有阻止，随即拨打电话，低沉说道：“阿龙，进来。”
话音刚落，包厢房门被人打开，走进来一个寸头男子，身材魁梧，肌肉紧绷，冷峻的眼神犹如鹰眼般锐利，摄人心魄，仿佛随时准备着应对任何潜在威胁。
叫阿龙的中年人扫了眼地上重伤不起的保镖，又扫了眼悠闲抽着雪茄的年轻人，看着四分五裂的大理石茶几，目光微微一凝，走到破碎的茶几前微微躬身，“刘老板，什么事？”
瞥了眼依然悠闲抽着雪茄的江凡，刘天虎冷哼一声，死到临头还不知道天高地厚，咬牙切齿说道：“同这位小兄弟切磋切磋，让他知道我刘天虎凭什么在金陵呼风唤雨！”
“明白”
，阿龙后退数步，低头扭动头颅，脖颈间关节咯吱作响，双手摆了个起手式，颇有几分气势，铿锵有力说道：“还请赐教！”
高手，这阿龙绝对不是其他保镖可相提并论，众人眼神中闪过一丝担忧，担心看向江凡，不知江凡是否也能打败这位高手？
江凡扫了眼叫阿龙的保镖，体内有股轻微的内力波动，只是稍微厉害一些的练家子而已，随手一刀风刃便可轻松解决，放下手里的雪茄，起身缓步走到阿龙对面，作了个请的手势。
见江凡那风轻云淡的表情，阿龙暗暗皱眉，这年轻人到底有什么倚仗，厉喝一声，踏出两步，右拳狠狠砸向江凡胸部，行云流水招式在片刻间完成。
众人震惊看向出拳快若闪电的阿龙，又看向站在原地没有丝毫反应的江凡，八成是江凡没有反应过来，不忍看到江凡被一拳打飞的惨状，痛苦闭上双眼。
刘天虎可不这么想，江凡是内劲高手，之前短短几十秒轻松解决十多个保镖，又一脚横扫两个加起来三百五六十斤的保镖，怎么可能会没有反应过来，内心不免有些担心。
方圆一丈的神识范围内，江凡可以快速做出反应，待立原地不动，只是想检验下这具经历雷电炼体，又经历淬体液炼体的身体强度如何，最多也就是吐口鲜血而已。
砰，阿龙惊恐看向江凡，六成力道的一拳，只是让没有任何防备的江凡倒退两步，内心涌起一阵危险，没有乘胜追击，快速后退数步，做起防御准备。

没有任何防御硬受一拳，江凡顿时气血一阵翻涌，身体强度还是太差劲了些，需要继续购买淬体液炼体，看向阿龙摇了摇头，“速度一般，力道一般，不用试探，还是动用你的全力吧。”
“多谢指教，看拳！”
阿龙厉喝一声，再次发动攻击，只是没有出拳，右腿以迅雷不及掩耳速度向着江凡脖颈击去，定要让这嚣张的年轻人付出代价。
“小心！”
牧华伟、张兆庆、李子茜等人纷纷出声提醒，愤怒看向狡诈的阿龙，高手过招，以大欺小也就算了，怎么能如此没有节操！
江凡暗暗摇头，要是没有突破炼气修为，可能会与阿龙平分秋色，可惜江凡突破炼气一层一周有余，扫了眼迎面袭来的凌厉腿法，身体诡异向左扭曲，躲过阿龙的攻击，右手猛抓阿龙小腿，左手化掌为拳猛击阿龙腹部。
阿龙瞬间亡魂大冒，这年轻人是如何躲过他的横扫攻击，咯吱，小腿传来钻心的疼痛，随后腹部传来肋骨的断裂声响，连喷三口鲜血，不可置信看着江凡，他居然连这年轻人一招接不下，还身受重伤！
砰砰砰，刘天虎惊恐看向砸翻沙发的阿龙，脸色一阵惨白，阿龙的战斗力在金陵黑道势力可以排进前三，在以往的开疆拓土中立下悍马功劳，竟然被江凡一招击败，那江凡实力又恐怖到何种程度！
不是猛龙不过江，刘天虎瞬间毛骨悚然，身体禁不住剧烈打颤，这年轻人到底是谁？金陵什么时候出了这么一个狠人？
牧华伟、张兆庆、李子茜等人纷纷倒吸一口冷气，想过江凡的武功很恐怖，可从未想到江凡电光火石间秒杀彪悍的阿龙，那江凡真正的实力又恐怖到何种地步？
江凡轻拍身上灰尘，回到之前位置，悠闲拿起烟灰缸里的雪茄，轻轻抽了一口，朝着刘天虎再次吐了个烟圈，“刘老板，切磋结束，阿龙的实力也不怎么样，还有什么底牌，你可以继续打电话。”
“江山代有才人出，一代新人换旧人，江公子果真是百年难遇的奇才”
，刘天虎客气恭维道，眼神闪过一丝精光，左手掏向西服上衣口袋，“那我就再喊金陵第一高手来同江公子切磋切磋！”
江凡鄙夷扫了眼刘天虎，真当哥的神识是摆设，进包厢第一刻便把整个包厢扫了遍，早发现你西装口袋的手枪，随即玩味看向刘天虎，“刘老板，不用那么小心翼翼，你可以大大方方把手枪掏出来，你也可以开枪试试！”
什么，李子茜、张思雯、柴书敏、方静怡等女瞳孔瞬间一阵紧缩，这黑道大佬刘天虎的身上居然藏有严格管控的手枪，那可是让人一枪致命的手枪！

content_en:
What, looking at the incredible scene in front of them, Mu Huawei, Zhang Zhaoqing, Li Ziqian and others couldn't help but start to doubt life. It would be fine if they hit it hard, but Jiang Fan just hit it lightly with his fingers, and the two-centimeter-thick marble tabletop suddenly broke. How did Jiang Fan do it?
Liu Tianhu, a master of internal energy, felt a turmoil in his heart. He looked at the young Jiang Fan in disbelief. Only a master of internal energy could easily do what he saw in front of him. But how could Jiang Fan, who looked like a young man under twenty years old, become a master of internal energy.
In an instant, the huge supreme box fell into silence. A group of strong men in black sat in the corner and did not dare to make a sound. Fatty Wang was almost frightened out of his wits. His crotch became wet involuntarily. Bruce Lee could not be so strong. Is this young man a human or a ghost?
"Boss Liu, what did you just say?"
Jiang Fan took another puff of the cigar, savored it in his mouth for a moment, and then blew out a few white smoke rings again, drifting in the direction of Liu Tianhu.
What is domineering, what is arrogance, what is a real man? Li Ziqian looked at Ye Fan who was smoking a cigar leisurely like a nymphomaniac. For a moment, she was a little jealous of her best friend Zi Ling. Why didn't she have a brother like Jiang Fan?
Mu Huawei and Zhang Zhaoqing looked at each other and smiled bitterly. Jiang Fan, whose fighting prowess is so incredible, is the abandoned young man of the Qin family. If the old man of the Qin family knew that his eldest grandson was so awesome, he would probably feel regretful. He would kneel down and ask Jiang Fan to return to the Qin family!
Liu Tianhu's face turned blue and white. He was very annoyed that the sound insulation of the Supreme Box was extremely good. A lot of furniture was smashed inside, but people outside could not hear the slightest movement. He took out his Vertu business phone from his pocket. Seeing that Jiang Fan didn't stop him, he immediately made a call and said in a low voice: "Aaron, come in."
As soon as he finished speaking, the door of the private room was opened, and a short-haired man walked in. He was tall, with tight muscles, and his cold eyes were as sharp as an eagle's eye. It was breathtaking, as if he was ready to deal with any potential threats at any time.
The middle-aged man named Aaron glanced at the bodyguard who was seriously injured on the ground, and then at the young man smoking a cigar leisurely. He looked at the broken marble coffee table, his eyes narrowed slightly, and he walked to the broken coffee table and bowed slightly, "Boss Liu, what's the matter?"
Glancing at Jiang Fan, who was still smoking a cigar leisurely, Liu Tianhu snorted coldly. He didn't know the heights of the world before his death, so he gritted his teeth and said: "Let's compete with this little brother and let him know why I, Liu Tianhu, can control the wind and rain in Jinling!"
"Understand"
, Aaron took a few steps back, lowered his head and twisted his head, the joints in his neck creaked, and he made a hand gesture with his hands, quite imposing, and said sonorously: "Please enlighten me!"
Master, this Aaron is definitely not comparable to other bodyguards. A trace of worry flashed in everyone's eyes. They looked at Jiang Fan worriedly. I wonder if Jiang Fan can defeat this master?
Jiang Fan glanced at the bodyguard named Aaron. There was a slight internal fluctuation in his body. It was just a slightly more powerful Lianjiazi. He could easily solve it with a casual wind blade. He put down the cigar in his hand, got up and walked slowly to the opposite side of Aaron, making a sign of invitation.
Seeing Jiang Fan's calm expression, Aaron frowned secretly. What did this young man have to rely on? He shouted sharply, took two steps, and hit Jiang Fan's chest with his right fist. The flowing moves were completed in a moment.
Everyone was shocked and looked at Aaron, who punched as fast as lightning, and then at Jiang Fan, who was standing there without any reaction. It was probably Jiang Fan who didn't react. They couldn't bear to see the tragic scene of Jiang Fan being knocked away by the punch, so they closed their eyes in pain.
Liu Tianhu didn't think so. Jiang Fan was a master of internal strength. He had easily eliminated more than a dozen bodyguards in just a few dozen seconds, and then swept two bodyguards weighing a total of 356 kilograms with one kick. How could he not react? He couldn't help but feel worried.
Within a radius of one foot, Jiang Fan can quickly doAfter reacting, he stood still, just to test the strength of this body that had undergone thunder and lightning refining and body tempering liquid refining. The most he could do was spit out blood.
Bang, Aaron looked at Jiang Fan in horror. A punch with 60% strength only made the unprepared Jiang Fan take two steps back. A sense of danger surged in his heart. Instead of pursuing the victory, he quickly took a few steps back to prepare for defense.
Jiang Fan received a punch without any defense, and his energy and blood suddenly surged. His physical strength was still too low, and he needed to continue to buy body tempering liquid to refine his body. He looked at Aaron and shook his head, "The speed is average, the strength is average, no need to test, just use your full strength."
"Thanks for the advice, let's watch the boxing!"
Aaron shouted sharply and launched another attack, but without punching, his right leg struck Jiang Fan's neck at lightning speed, making sure to make this arrogant young man pay the price.
"Be careful!"
Mu Huawei, Zhang Zhaoqing, Li Ziqian and others all shouted out reminders and looked angrily at the cunning Aaron. It's okay to use the big to bully the small. How can you be so unruly!
Jiang Fan secretly shook his head. If he hadn't broken through the Qi refining level, he might be on par with Aaron. Unfortunately, Jiang Fan had broken through to the first level of Qi refining for more than a week. He glanced at the oncoming fierce kicks and twisted his body strangely to the left to avoid Aaron's attack. He grabbed Aaron's calf with his right hand and turned his left hand into a fist to punch Aaron's abdomen.
Aaron's soul suddenly erupted. How did the young man dodge his sweeping attack? He felt a heartbreaking pain in his calf, and then there was a sound of ribs breaking in his abdomen. He spurted three mouthfuls of blood. He looked at Jiang Fan in disbelief. He couldn't even catch this young man's attack and was seriously injured!
Bang bang bang, Liu Tianhu looked at Aaron who had smashed the sofa in horror, his face turned pale for a moment. Aaron's combat effectiveness can be ranked among the top three in the Jinling underworld. He has made contributions to the Hummer in the past expansion of territory, but he was defeated by Jiang Fan with one move. How terrifying is Jiang Fan's strength!
It's not that the dragon can't cross the river. Liu Tianhu was instantly terrified and his body couldn't help but tremble violently. Who is this young man? When did such a ruthless person appear in Jinling?
Mu Huawei, Zhang Zhaoqing, Li Ziqian and others all took a breath of air. They thought that Jiang Fan's martial arts was terrifying, but they never thought that Jiang Fan could kill the mighty Aaron instantly with lightning and flint. So how terrifying is Jiang Fan's true strength?
Jiang Fan dusted himself lightly, returned to his previous position, leisurely picked up the cigar in the ashtray, took a puff, and blew out a smoke ring again towards Liu Tianhu, "Boss Liu, the discussion is over. Aaron's strength is not very good. If you have any other trump cards, you can continue to call."
"Talented people emerge from generation to generation, and new generations replace old ones. Mr. Jiang is really a rare talent that can only be seen in a century."
, Liu Tianhu politely complimented, his eyes flashed with a glint, and he reached into the pocket of his suit jacket with his left hand, "Then I will call the top master in Jinling to come and compete with Mr. Jiang!"
Jiang Fan glanced at Liu Tianhu with disdain. He really thought that his spiritual consciousness was just a decoration. He scanned the whole box the moment he entered the box and found the pistol in your suit pocket. Then he looked at Liu Tianhu playfully, "Boss Liu, don't be so careful. You can take out the pistol freely and you can also try shooting!"
What, the pupils of Li Ziqian, Zhang Siwen, Chai Shumin, Fang Jingyi and other women shrank instantly. The underworld boss Liu Tianhu actually had a strictly controlled pistol hidden in his body. It was a fatal pistol!
